title: Generated VIEW LiveSection SECTIONOBJECT graph and DXF transport
scope: Bounded VIEW group-334 adapter output for one uniquely retained SECTIONOBJECT target.

format_contract.finding: Group 334 is an optional soft-pointer ID/handle to a live section object.
format_contract.semantic_finding: Restoring a named view with an associated section object activates live sectioning for that object.

implementation.low_level: dxfRW::writeView now serializes group 334 only for AC1021+ when the source handle is explicitly registered as resolved; the configured resolver or handle remap supplies the emitted identity. Zero and NoHandle results refuse before record publication.
implementation.adapter: validateLayoutGraph resolves each nonzero VIEW target to exactly one typed DRW_SectionObject with the SECTION entity tag in the retained entity census. The adapter preallocates the target identity before VIEW table output and registers it with the low-level writer.
implementation.bounded_profile: The current graph does not close SECTIONOBJECT group-360 SECTION_SETTINGS dependencies. A referenced SectionObject with a nonzero settings handle remains atomically refused.
implementation.abi: Adds private dxfRW writer-state storage and a public setup setter. Downstream binary consumers must rebuild; ABI compatibility is not claimed by this slice.

validation.inputs: Generated ASCII/Binary VIEW input and locally authored in-memory SECTIONOBJECT; no DWG/DXF fixture was added.
cases: Exact remapped/resolved group-334 identity and SECTIONOBJECT group-5 identity are equal after output.
Fresh adapter readback resolves VIEW group 334 to the emitted SECTIONOBJECT handle.
Missing target, wrong entity kind, duplicate SECTIONOBJECT handle, unresolved SECTION_SETTINGS edge, and pre-AC1021 target version preserve the existing destination.
Low-level VIEW reference tests cover resolver precedence, remap fallback, unresolved-result refusal, and fresh-writer retry.
The prior direct-writer fail-closed control passes when no target registration is supplied.

qualification_limits: Generated transport and target-kind closure only; physical producer field-span/source-owner evidence remains open.
SECTION_SETTINGS graph closure remains explicitly refused for this profile.
No native AutoCAD/FreeCAD live-section behavior or 3D section semantics is qualified.
